roadmap: 10 ⑧ edit a part in place inside an assembly, v1 (user request 2026-10-31)

issues.#538: stays open (ASM-06 multi-part edit / reference refresh advanced)

tier: full (document-mode switching, undo/redo, autosave/recovery, definition commits: three audit rounds with mutation, actual run)
before: a part placed in an assembly could only change through a separate file and New revision… + Accept; in-assembly editing covered bearing features only

change.session: Instance panel 'Edit part' on a top-level instance: the definition becomes the working document in its own coordinates (every tool, the History bar and Undo/Redo work inside it), evaluated with the rows the assembly gives it; the assembly's undo/redo, marker and dirty flag are set aside
change.context: the assembly's own bodies and the other placed instances shown see-through and unpickable, moved by the inverse of the edited instance's placement
change.banner: 'Editing <name> · shared by N' with Finish / Cancel (Cancel with changes asks Discard / Keep editing); Esc does not cancel; explanation behind Details
change.commit: model editDefinition: every instance sharing the part id takes the edited document at the next revision (never backwards: next(max(placed rev, drawing rev))); own-part instance replaced; a pattern copy stands for its seed; looks and joints kept, held looks reported; waiting revisions of that part cleared, a linked source marked '(edited)'; unchanged → no commit; refuses the assembly itself or a part placing the part it replaces; Finish refuses a part that does not compute; one assembly Undo step
change.guards: Save/Save shared/Open/New/Templates/Project/versions/recovery Restore blocked; recovery and project autosave skipped; beforeunload warns; entry refused during a command, sketch, drawing, render, measure, mate draft, cage/skeleton, variant, ghost, a chat turn, an import or mesh question, or a project file opening; an open finishing during a session is abandoned before it switches file; a chat turn that ends on the other document is dropped and merges no version log

audits.round1: CHANGES_REQUIRED: high — context bodies placed twice (other instances were already in assembly coordinates); high — a chat turn, an import or a project open could replace the session's document and Finish would commit it into every sharer; medium — revision going backwards, a waiting older file reverting the edit, inherited rows missing; low — toasts, Finish on a failing part, export names — all fixed
audits.round2: CHANGES_REQUIRED: high — a project open in flight could make Finish/autosave/Cmd+S write the assembly over another project file; medium — a session turn's make_version could land in the assembly's history — fixed; 5/5 mutants killed
audits.round3: targeted: ACCEPT; 2 mutants killed; call sites correctly wired (not themselves covered by tests: follow-up)

docs: reference/document.md now names instancePatterns and the instance fields joints/looks/pattern (check-docs had failed since D383 — the check was not run then)

actualRun.run04: final source PASS on edit-in-place.bcad (Cube 1 at (0, 20, 0) turned 30°): Cube 2 'Edit part' → banner 'Editing Cube 2 · shared by 2', the working document is the cube definition; width 20 → 30 in the feature editor; Cmd+S refused with a toast, nothing downloaded; Finish → both occurrences hold the edited definition at Rev B with placements kept (oracle PASS); Undo restores the whole assembly, Redo; a second session changed then Cancel → Discard leaves it unchanged; 0 page/console errors; root reviewed the screenshots
failedRuns: run01: the driver changed the editor's first value (the width) and checked the height (driver)

followUps: the guard call sites (openedImport/onOpened/onLinked/openPart canOpen/after versionsToMerge) are wired but not themselves covered by tests
nested sub-assembly parts cannot be edited in place yet (no button; the nested card explains)
the context is a static snapshot at Begin (joint/explode poses ignored)
a project-folder open in flight is not counted (no loss: the next Save refuses to overwrite)
the self-containment check compares objects, not values (no current path delivers a copy)
in-context references to other parts' geometry are out of v1
